qualification: Named MythicRatatoskr family with described shell, file-transfer, JSON check-in/tasking/result/getfile protocol, Yggdrasil HTTPS channel, exact configuration paths and C2 IPv6; sufficient concrete reconstructable artifacts.
reconstruction_limits: These are representative source implementations, not original malware or recovered source.

JSON message-type values, UUID, endpoint and documented command meanings are from ESET. Envelope key spellings, task field names, response containers, exception handling and helper organization are illustrative because the report does not publish their exact wire schema.

Go implements Windows and Unix shell dispatch; Python assumes an installed route to the overlay. Neither reconstructs Yggstack itself, its public peer selection, reverse SOCKS, service persistence, screenshot capture, or AES configuration storage.
No execution of either agent occurred. Go was cross-compiled for Windows to verify source validity; Python was parsed with ast. The built PE remains outside the sample set.
No trait infers a wiper, startup-delay evasion, screenshot theft, Linux crond persistence, or malicious public peers without supporting evidence.

placement.ip_observation: micro-behaviors/communications/ip/literal records HTTP URL range syntax and decoded variants without asserting contact or intent.
placement.json_post: micro-behaviors/communications/http/request/json records a real Go http.Post call with its JSON media-type argument.
placement.protocol: objectives/command-and-control/backdoor/tasking/json-http combines four distinct message roles with an actual JSON HTTP client; individual words are incomplete components.
placement.tasking: objectives/command-and-control/remote-command/tasking combines that protocol with shell/file dispatch, execution, and repeated polling. Proximity is described explicitly; whole-program data flow is not claimed.
placement.channel: objectives/command-and-control/channel/yggdrasil requires the admitted agent plus an overlay-range endpoint; description says includes, not proven transport data flow.
placement.identity_independence: No required family name, filename, exact hash, hardcoded key, fixed UUID, precise endpoint, package marker, or exact sample size.

false_positive_fixes: Password-field matcher now requires record/line key syntax; a pwd shell task is not a password field.
Terminal dispatch now requires argv; a remote download task is not a CLI operation.
Preserve the existing vendor-tunnel exception using an indexed-value branch at its neutral control-flow home.
